channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: IRONMAN OF THE YEAR: Tigers’ Nelson ‘a ball player’ in every sense
item.description: Wilson Prep’s Ethan Nelson did it all — from running back to kicker — capped by a first-ever field goal to win the state 1-A title and Wilson’s first football championship since 1969.

item.title: IRONMAN OF THE YEAR: Howard the secret spice to Hunt’s success
item.description: Transfer senior Jamauris Howard became Hunt High's all-around weapon, powering a 12-win run to the 5-A title game and earning rare four-time All-Area and Wilson Times Ironman of the Year honors.

item.title: DEFENSIVE PLAYER OF THE YEAR: Harris helps Warriors D return to Mojoville
item.description: After a broken leg, Hunt junior linebacker and judo champ Judah Harris powered the Warriors back to the 5-A title game with 191 tackles, earning Wilson Times Defensive Player of the Year.

item.title: OFFENSIVE PLAYER OF THE YEAR: Usher a dominant force for Wilson Prep in title run
item.description: Versatile senior Travon Usher powered Wilson Prep’s rapid rise from startup program to 1-A state champion, earning Times Offensive Player of the Year after a 1,800-yard season.

item.title: ‘Blessed by God’: Grant helps Elm City man replace damaged home
item.description: A $950,000 grant will replace or repair several Elm City homes, including a fire-damaged house, giving longtime resident Jerry Draper a long-awaited fresh start.

item.title: No. 2 Eagles too much for No. 4 Knights
item.description: No. 2 Rocky Mount Academy crushes No. 4 Greenfield 57-20 behind Taylor Carmichael’s 23 points, handing the Knights a second straight loss.

item.title: Edwards reconsiders as Greenfield overruns RMA, 84-30
item.description: Top-ranked Greenfield cruises past Rocky Mount Academy 84-30 behind balanced scoring, as standout senior Kobe Edwards decommits from Elon and reopens his recruitment.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 8-9, 2026
item.description: Area high school sports schedule for Jan. 8-9, 2026, features packed slates of boys and girls hoops, JV action, wrestling and swimming across Wilson, Greene and beyond.

item.title: Strength can be found in vulnerability more than suppression
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor reflects on confusing suppression with strength, arguing that real resilience—for athletes and in everyday life—comes from vulnerability.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Katie McBryde, Wilson Christian Academy
item.description: Wilson Christian junior forward Katie McBryde, a three-sport standout with a 3.75 GPA, earns Student-Athlete of the Week after a 24-point, 12-rebound performance in a road win.
